detector_arrays.name: Detector Array 1 (D1)
detector_arrays.primary_science: Optical-NIR transition, stellar classification, high proper motion stars, Barnard's Star baseline

detector_arrays.name: Detector Array 2 (D2)
detector_arrays.primary_science: H2O 1.4 um absorption, J & H astronomical bands, early T-dwarf characterization

detector_arrays.name: Detector Array 3 (D3)
detector_arrays.primary_science: H2O 1.9 um absorption, CO bands, K-band infrared continuum, methane in brown dwarfs

detector_arrays.name: Detector Array 4 (D4)
detector_arrays.primary_science: H2O ice absorption (3.05 um), aliphatic hydrocarbons (3.4 um), high resolution interstellar ice mapping

detector_arrays.name: Detector Array 5 (D5)
detector_arrays.primary_science: CO2 ice absorption (4.27 um), ultracool brown dwarf continuum (WISE 0855 peak window)

detector_arrays.name: Detector Array 6 (D6)
detector_arrays.primary_science: CO gas/ice (4.67 um), XCN ices, coldest sub-stellar atmospheres and distant TNOs / Planet X candidates
